🎥 Behind the Scenes at the Tesla Model S & Model X Signature Edition Delivery Event | Fremont Factory

We were invited to the exclusive, invite-only Tesla Signature Edition Delivery Event at the Fremont Factory — the emotional farewell celebration for the final limited run of Model S and Model X.

In this behind-the-scenes video, experience what it was really like: 
• Arriving at the Fremont Factory for this historic send-off 
• The incredible atmosphere as owners took delivery of their ultra-rare Signature Editions 
• Close-up details: Garnet Red paint, gold accents, badging, numbered plaques, and special interior touches 
• Raw, unscripted moments from the event 
• Special highlights where @elonmusk @larsmoravy @woodhaus2 @hrushisagar  shared heartfelt stories about the early days of the Model S and Model X

Only 150 Model S and 100 Model X Signature Editions were ever made — true collector’s cars marking the end of an era for the current generation flagships.

📍 Fremont Factory, California – May 20, 2026
